IFS.US.revenueEvidence: 2025 segment table, total consolidated column after eliminations: total income PEN 11,326,379 thousand. Currency independently corroborated by total assets, common equity and operating cash flow; vendor USD label is wrong.

ING.US.revenueEvidence: Consolidated ING Group IFRS-EU total income 23,035 million matches the input IFRS-EU net income 6,327 million. Undimensioned IFRS-IASB revenue 25,678 million corresponds to net income 8,324 million and must not be mixed with the EU basis. The reconciliation identifies the IAS 39 EU carve-out.

CIB.US.revenueEvidence: Consolidated statement F-7: net interest and valuation before credit impairment + net fees + other operating income + dividends/equity income. FY2025 COP million: 19,426,300 + 4,354,944 + 3,572,074 + 693,011 = 28,046,329. Continues the bank net-revenue definition; gross interest is not revenue.

NOG.US.reason: Audited consolidated total revenues include settled and unsettled commodity derivative gains; vendor sales subtotal excluded those gains.
